summary: Wrote tapeout/release_notes.md for alu8 (sky130A, 75 MHz). It shows the 16/16 checklist items marked done, each with its evidence link. Readiness is Baseline A (open SKY130 shuttle) 95.3% and Baseline B (commercial production) 64.1%, with the per-check breakdown. DFM has 0 high, 2 medium and 5 low items. The notes also list known limits and open items. I ran no tools and make no new pass/fail claim.
assumptions: Checklist 'done' flags and readiness results are taken as recorded in the input reports. I did not re-verify them in this task.
G4 here means submission to an open SKY130 shuttle (Baseline A); commercial production (Baseline B) is out of Phase 0 scope.
No division budget or forecast was provided in the inputs; cost is reported as run spend by agent only, without totals I computed.
No escaped defects exist beyond what the inputs report (the inputs list none).
Package contents are listed from checklist item 15 and the role description. I did not inspect the tapeout directory.
Score totals 92.5/97 (A) and 68.0/106 (B) were summed by hand from the rows. They match the reported 95.3% and 64.1%.
The 9 STA corners are the PDK typical/slow/fast corners, as stated in the readiness assumptions.
The report files supplied are the current results for run run_01M44DR7XRWAQ9XY53AG8SRJCM; their pass/fail values are as recorded and are re-verified by the runtime, not by me.
open_issues: Baseline B is 64.1%: the package is not production-signoff-ready. Closing the gaps needs Phase 1 commercial tools.
DFM medium items DFM-003 (35 met1 near-minimum line ends) and DFM-001 (7 li windows near max density) remain open (owner: Orion).
Division budget and weekly forecast are missing; need Penny to supply them so spend vs budget can be reported.
G4 is a human decision; no gate has been approved by this report.
I/O delays of 4.0 ns are DEFAULT values pending customer confirmation.
IR/EM row: EM was not analyzed, so it earns only 2 of 4 points even under Baseline A.
Medium DFM items DFM-003 (35 met1 line ends) and DFM-001 (7 li windows near max density 0.6) need a fix-or-accept decision before G4.
OpenLane power figure 0.00020245423365850002 W does not match OpenSTA tt total 0.0002593128 W; basis of the OpenLane figure unknown.
STA input does not record netlist stage or parasitics source (REQ-014 requires post-route); runtime should confirm.
pv_signoff layer density values (m3 0.9709549895759344, m4 0.9667335964672477, m5 1.0) conflict with DFM-006's stated met3 density of 2.9%; Fabian/Orion to clarify what each measures.
spec.yaml still lists six 'DEFAULT - needs G1 review' open questions. G1 is recorded as approved, but the inputs do not show that each default was explicitly confirmed.

tapeout_readiness gaps list says 'fix and re-run the check (this phase)' for signal integrity, reliability and foundry signoff, while row notes say they are out of open-flow scope; wording to be corrected by the owner.

tapeout_readiness.json is inconsistent for signal integrity, reliability and foundry signoff: the gaps say 'fix and re-run the check (this phase)', but the rows say 'out of open-flow scope'. A human should decide which is right.
